name: bge-m3-italian
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-m3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 8194). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (XLM-RoBERTa), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-27. A finetune of BAAI/bge-m3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.568 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2026-09-12. Caveat: the headline MTEB XPQA/STS22 numbers are self-reported on the card but are independently reproducible - the model is registered in the mteb results repo, and the card notes none of those tasks was used for training. The training-distribution rows are honest about losses: sparse-only on short passages is worse than base (0.450 vs 0.474, significant), dense-only on long documents is 0.019 below base (not significant). Hybrid is the configuration that wins.
